title: Layered Encoding
summary: A transmission was wrapped in several reversible encodings. Peel them back.
briefing:
An outbound relay queue holds a payload that someone wrapped in more than one reversible transform to make it look opaque.

None of these transforms use a key, so none of them is encryption. Identify each layer in turn, undo it, and recover the original text.

The inner message is a flag.
objectives: Identify the outermost encoding from its alphabet and padding

hints.title: Magic
hints.text: The CyberChef "Magic" operation can suggest the first layer. Confirm each suggestion yourself instead of trusting it blindly.

hints.title: Layer order
hints.text: The text is Base64 on the outside. Inside that is a hex string. Inside that is a classical rotation cipher.
